requirement: Clients in 10.0.1.0/24 must reach the web server network 10.0.2.0/24 but must not reach the management network 10.0.99.0/24.

proposal.rationale: To ensure that clients in the 10.0.1.0/24 subnet can reach the web server network 10.0.2.0/24 but cannot reach the management network 10.0.99.0/24, we need to configure static routes and access control rules on both routers.
